mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.tenant_id,r.task_id FROM reservation r JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND t.id=r.task_id LEFT JOIN mcp_result m ON m.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND m.task_id=r.task_id AND r.id=CONCAT('mcp:',m.root_invocation_id) WHERE r.category='MCP_RESULT' AND r.state IN ('RESERVED','SETTLED') AND t.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND (m.expires_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR m.root_invocation_id IS NULL AND t.updated_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 7 DAY) LIMIT 32
SELECT id FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND state='HELD_UNKNOWN'

SELECT r.tenant_id,r.id,r.task_id,r.dispatch_id,r.category,r.amount,r.actual,r.usage_quality,r.cost_quality,r.state,r.record_version FROM reservation r LEFT JOIN mcp_result m ON m.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND m.task_id=r.task_id AND r.id=CONCAT('mcp:',m.root_invocation_id) WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND r.task_id=#{taskId} AND r.category='MCP_RESULT' AND r.state IN ('RESERVED','SETTLED') AND (m.expires_at<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) OR m.root_invocation_id IS NULL AND #{updatedAt}<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 7 DAY) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mcp_result SET body=NULL,state='DELETED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND root_invocation_id=#{root}
